name: 天然成熟琥珀蜂蜜森野款
description: 森野花海产地叙事，琥珀蜜体微距与酿蜜工序时间轴建立天然成熟信任

styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight 5300K for scenes, warm soft studio key front-left for product, soft contact shadow, no hard flash

styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; green #3A7D33 or amber #B4690E headlines, short two-level labels, all in-image Chinese wrapped in 「」

styleLock.presentationRules: jar always upright, stable slight 3/4 hero angle for photo shots, centered stability for infographic shots, consistent jar scale across the set
styleLock.lockText: warm natural food ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream off-white #FFF9EE, honey amber #F5A623, leaf green #3A7D33 text accents and deep amber #B4690E as the single accent; warm tone throughout; modern geometric sans-serif headlines and short two-level labels; backgrounds alternate among cream panels, honey-amber texture panels, white infographic pages and dark walnut wood surfaces joined by a honey-drip divider motif; bright soft daylight or warm front-left studio key with soft contact shadow; consistent rounded photo tiles, thin-line hexagon badges and numbered timeline circles; clean food photography with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; every frame a complete balanced composition; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.textZone: top center headline 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D above the drip crown; a small circular seal badge in #D4AF37 carrying 「{selling_point_1}」 left of the headline

provenance.notes: 源自 800×1200 长图切片 8 片。源文件夹为保健/蜂蜜，但图内实为普通食用蜂蜜（野花/荆条蜜罐装），按 taxonomy 归入 食品饮料/冲调 而非医药保健。已剥离：品牌字与红印章、罐身标签图文、二维码与会员角标、真实产地地名、执行标准号、净含量/保质期等具体数值、圆环图 1%/45%/54% 统计口径与波美度/含水量宣称——不可验证数值一律不带入，以 {callout}/{selling_point} 具名文案槽重建，图表镜只写文字性描述不出现数字口径；图中人物仅保留手部/背影角色，不携带身份特征；收口镜的二维码预留区弃用，改为实色角标元素。产地大景（shot-04）与环形图表（shot-03）按原版式保留小产品占比，属版式优先。产品一律以 {product} 占位。
